description: This file defines the API and data structures for managing arrays of object identifiers (oids), including functions for appending, searching, filtering, sorting, and iterating over oid arrays. It facilitates efficient handling of large sets of object IDs, primarily for use in larger software projects that deal with object tracking or version control systems.

classes.name: oid_array
classes.description: Represents a dynamic array of object IDs with internal management for size, allocation, and sorting status.

methods.name: oid_array_append
methods.description: Adds an object ID to the end of the oid_array, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: oid_array_lookup
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find an object ID in the array, sorting if it is not already sorted.

methods.name: oid_array_clear
methods.description: Frees memory used by the array and resets it to an empty state.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each
methods.description: Iterates over each oid in the array, executing a callback function.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each_unique
methods.description: Iterates over each unique oid in sorted order, executing a callback function.

methods.name: oid_array_filter
methods.description: Filters the array in-place based on a predicate callback, retaining only matching items.

methods.name: oid_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts the array of object IDs in ascending order.

methods.name: size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array * array,size_t cur)
methods.description: Returns the index of the next unique object ID after the current position in a sorted array.

ctags.name: oid_array_next_unique
ctags.pattern: /^static inline size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array *array, size_t cur)$/
